correctness.rationale: For a Dyck word with n-2 peaks, exactly four equal-letter adjacencies make its mismatch with the alternating word exactly two nonempty interval runs. A set of five ordered positions with alternating 1-0-1-0-1 cannot be shattered by two intervals; the 16 traces on positions 2,4,7,8 at n=6 and padding with (UD) tails prove VC=4 for every n>=6. The suffix interval-to-threshold embedding after the UUDD prefix proves unbounded online dimension with floor(log2(n-3)) lower bound. The exact boolean recurrence over all nonempty hypothesis subsets, using complete coordinate splits and exact 2^depth leaf cutoff, proves each finite Ldim n=3..11, rather than extrapolation. The independent finite solver enumerated all 3..11 layers including 825 hypotheses at n=11, 60,564 memoized states, and reproduced the listed dimensions and witness traces. Boundaries n=3,4,5 were separately enumerated. No formula is asserted for the full Ldim sequence past 11.
